headline: Together AI says an unauthorized party used an exposed credential to download stored test prompts from June and July.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (4 Tier 1, 1 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 14 claims, 5 questions. Together AI's own post confirms an unauthorized party used an exposed credential to download stored prompt samples. Tied to OpenRouter's post on data processing incidents and the Phala and Novita notices it links. No attacker named and no customer count. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
